Sam: quick poll — our office fiddle leaf fig gets to choose an editor + a model codename. Vote by replying with the option number + a short codename. Options: 1) VSCode, 2) Vim, 3) Emacs, 4) Nova, 5) Nano. (winner decides who brings plant snacks tomorrow) :seedling:
Alex: 2) Vim — codename: 'leaf-slate' :thumbsup:
Maria: 1) VSCode — codename: 'fern-compiler' :sparkles:
Jordan: 3) Emacs — codename: 'plant-lisp' :herb:
Lee: 4) Nova — codename: 'photosynth-7' :camera_flash:
Ava: 5) Nano — codename: 'tiny-root' :ok_hand:
Sam: haha these are all amazing names. Tally so far: Vim 1, VSCode 1, Emacs 1, Nova 1, Nano 1 — perfect tie :neutral_face:
DevBot: snack-bot recorded the votes. Current reactions: :seedling: :herb:
Maria: tie-breaker rule: fastest editor wins. who wants to demo their pick in 15s tomorrow? :clock1:
Jordan: I can demo Emacs — will bring matchstick cookies :cookie:
Alex: if Vim wins i'll bring bagels :bagel:
Lee: i can show Nova's UI in 15s, and bring iced tea :ice_cube:
Ava: tiny-root appreciates the support :smile:
Sam: ok closing poll at 10:00am PT tomorrow. chaotic but productive :laughing:
